attempts.result: The first PowerShell wrapper placed a PYTHONPATH assignment after a pipeline operator and failed parsing before Python or Docker inspection ran.
attempts.corrected_by: The corrected wrapper set the environment before the pipeline and passed the existing exact boundary implementation.

attempts.corrected_by: The complete locked evaluator restarted, passed independently, and a corrected patch retained its exact full result as IS-0005-U04-repeated-dashboard-result.json.
